root_cause: The fetchers (_fetch_imd_bulletins, _fetch_gdacs_active_systems, _fetch_jtwc_active_systems) caught exceptions internally and returned an empty list. Caller sync_all_sources interpreted an empty list as a healthy feed with no active storms instead of distinguishing failures.
implementation_summary: Created FeedResult and FeedStatus models in backend/app/models/feed_result.py. Refactored _fetch_imd_bulletins, _fetch_gdacs_active_systems, and _fetch_jtwc_active_systems to return FeedResult. Rewrote sync_all_sources to inspect FeedResult.status, preserve valid records as STALE during outages, and distinguish confirmed calm from feed failures.
verification_evidence: test_feed_failure_semantics.py executed with 8 passed tests verifying all feed outage and reconciliation states.

root_cause: Missing wind readings defaulted to arbitrary numeric speeds (e.g. 65 km/h for GDACS, 35 kt for JTWC), fabricated headings/steering speeds in trajectory calculations, and current retrieval timestamp presented as observation timestamp.
implementation_summary: Replaced missing wind and pressure defaults with None across GDACS, JTWC, and IMD fetchers. Separated storm classification from numeric wind values. Stamped data_quality schema with UNAVAILABLE / OBSERVED provenance. Extracted authentic pubDate observation times and avoided defaulting to current UTC retrieval timestamp.
verification_evidence: Asserted intensity_knots and central_pressure_hpa remain None end to end and dvorak_t marks T-Pending without crashing.

root_cause: _calibrate_system_telemetry generates future and past waypoints using hard-coded steering values and simplified intensity decay, presenting generated points without explicit provenance labels or separate layer designations.
implementation_summary: Eliminated synthetic past hindcast waypoints (-18h, -9h) from live tracking. Explicitly labeled 0h fix as OFFICIAL_OBSERVATION and future horizons as EXPERIMENTAL_EXTRAPOLATION. Renamed method to 'Official Live Fix (0h) + Experimental Kinematic Extrapolation (Decision Support Layer Only)' and disclaimed numerical BAM claims.
test_results: Verified no time_offset_hours < 0 in generated track waypoints
verification_evidence: Inspected waypoint labels and verified method='EXPERIMENTAL_EXTRAPOLATION', origin_type='EXPERIMENTAL_EXTRAPOLATION', and time_offset_hours >= 0.

root_cause: Hardcoded active shelter counts (485/420) and mandatory evacuation labels in frontend and PDF generators; synoptic observations section displayed unmeasured derived values; client-side unverified CAP XML string templating.
implementation_summary: Refactored pdfReportGenerator.ts to partition observed synoptic telemetry (showing authentic values or 'Not available') from parametric model estimates with clear disclaimers. Replaced hardcoded shelter counts with 'Open Data Inventory (Consult DDMA)' and mandatory evacuation with 'Hazard Advisory Zone (Consult DDMA Directives)'. Updated reports/page.tsx with exercise warnings and verified Next.js production build passes with zero errors.
regression_tests: frontend build: npm run --prefix frontend build
test_results: Next.js Turbopack build and TypeScript type-check PASSED (exit code 0)
verification_evidence: Production compilation of Next.js frontend with all 15 routes generated successfully without TypeScript errors or invalid styling.

root_cause: When fewer than 3 images exist for a class, train_classifier.py duplicated identical images across train, validation, and test partitions, invalidating scientific evaluation integrity.
implementation_summary: Eliminated fallback image duplication. Defined InsufficientDatasetError and DataLeakageError. Implemented event-based disjoint splitting and cryptographic SHA-256 manifest verification across train, val, and test partitions. Separated developer smoke testing into backend/train_demo_classifier.py explicitly labeled as UNCALIBRATED_DEMO.
verification_evidence: Pytest executed 6 passed tests confirming dataset size enforcement, cryptographic hash collision detection, event leakage prevention, and safe halting on demo seed data.

root_cause: Classifier inference reported raw probabilities without calibrated uncertainty metrics or OOD detection; ambiguous predictions yielded forced classifications without human inspection triggers.
implementation_summary: Implemented calibrated uncertainty evaluation computing normalized Shannon entropy, MSP floor, top-1/top-2 margin, and energy scores in backend/app/services/ml_service.py. Triggers INSUFFICIENT_CONFIDENCE abstention when MSP < 0.60, entropy > 0.65, or margin < 0.15 with human meteorological inspection recommendation. Stamped all predictions with operational_status='EXPERIMENTAL_DECISION_SUPPORT_ONLY'.
verification_evidence: Pytest executed 5 passed unit and integration tests confirming abstention behavior, metric bounds, payload validation, and experimental status stamping.

root_cause: Flood zone service generated synthetic buffer ellipses rather than measured Sentinel-1 flood extents while labeling them as satellite flood detections.
implementation_summary: Architecturally segregated SatelliteFloodDetectionService from ExperimentalFloodSimulationService in backend/app/services/gee_service.py. When GEE credentials or satellite image passes are unavailable, returns SATELLITE_DATA_UNAVAILABLE with empty feature collection and zero fabricated polygons. Tagged all simulation features and collections with origin='EXPERIMENTAL_HYDROLOGICAL_SIMULATION' and is_satellite_measured=False.
test_results: All 30 tests in test_track5_services.py and test_comprehensive_remediation.py PASSED (44.53s)
verification_evidence: Pytest executed 4 dedicated tests confirming unauthenticated GEE returns SATELLITE_DATA_UNAVAILABLE without polygons, simulation features strictly tag EXPERIMENTAL_HYDROLOGICAL_SIMULATION, and regression tests pass.

root_cause: Authentication boundary lacked strict Clerk issuer/audience enforcement in production, trusted localhost origins in production mode, and permitted unverified metadata to determine application roles.
implementation_summary: Enforced strict production CORS origin filtering in backend/app/main.py (rejecting localhost and wildcard origins in production). Added production fallback resolver in frontend/src/lib/api.ts. Implemented exact role matching, constant-time admin secret validation, fail-closed HMAC secret length checks (>= 32 chars), and zero-trust algorithm=none rejection in backend/app/core/auth.py.
test_results: Authentication and authorization regression tests in test_comprehensive_remediation.py PASSED
verification_evidence: Pytest verified exact role matching, production key length enforcement, algorithm=none rejection, and constant-time comparison.

root_cause: Rate limiting operations lacked atomicity under concurrent requests and lacked a documented fail-closed degradation policy for privileged endpoints when Redis is unavailable.
implementation_summary: Implemented atomic Redis Lua script evaluating both minute and hour sliding windows using unique member UUIDs. Configured fail-closed policy (HTTP 503) when Redis is down in production with REDIS_FAIL_CLOSED=true. Enhanced bounded in-memory sliding window fallback with active stale record eviction and accurate X-RateLimit-* headers.
test_results: Rate limit header enforcement test in test_comprehensive_remediation.py PASSED
verification_evidence: Pytest executed 4 unit tests verifying in-memory window enforcement, header injection, production fail-closed behavior, and atomic Redis Lua script arguments.

root_cause: Worker leadership standby lacked continuous election, fencing against stale writes, and idempotent ingestion commits.
implementation_summary: Added monotonically increasing fencing generation token (_leader_generation) and implemented continuous leader election and automatic failover in step_leader_election / run_continuous_leader_election in backend/app/core/process_lock.py. Integrated continuous election in app lifespan (backend/app/main.py) to automatically promote standby workers on leader failure.
test_results: All 3 leader election tests in test_leader_election_resilience.py PASSED
verification_evidence: Pytest verified monotonic epoch generation increments on Redis acquisition, standby promotion, and automatic failover demotion.

root_cause: Readiness probe (/ready) did not comprehensively evaluate mandatory production dependencies (DB, Redis, Auth config, ML model) with accurate HTTP 503 fail-closed semantics.
implementation_summary: Refactored /ready and /health/ready in backend/app/main.py to evaluate database connection, fail-closed Redis status in production (returning HTTP 503 if unreachable when REDIS_FAIL_CLOSED=true), model initialization state, active worker leadership, and epoch generation.
test_results: Both readiness probe tests in test_leader_election_resilience.py PASSED
verification_evidence: Pytest verified HTTP 503 on database outage and comprehensive status reporting including leader generation.

root_cause: Absence of formal Alembic migration tooling in production and missing automated migration step in deployment manifests.
implementation_summary: Initialized Alembic migration environment in backend/alembic and backend/alembic.ini. Configured dynamic DATABASE_URL environment resolution in alembic/env.py. Generated initial baseline migration 7ebcad6e592b_initial_domain_models.py with idempotent DDL for all domain models (cyclone_archive, active_cyclone_state, classification_history). Added 'alembic upgrade head' to backend buildCommand in render.yaml.
verification_evidence: Programmatic execution of command.upgrade(alembic_cfg, 'head') completed successfully without errors.

root_cause: Broad or unpinned dependencies across backend and frontend environments without automated build-time migration execution or reproducible lockfile validation.
implementation_summary: Pinned dependency lower bounds in backend/requirements.txt (FastAPI >=0.110.0, PyTorch >=2.2.1, Alembic >=1.13.0, Redis >=5.0.0, PyJWT >=2.8.0, Cryptography >=42.0.0, SQLAlchemy >=2.0.28). Enforced reproducible frontend builds via package-lock.json in .github/workflows/ci.yml with npm ci. Configured render.yaml backend buildCommand to execute 'alembic upgrade head' prior to application boot.
test_results: Frontend production Turbopack compilation and TypeScript verification passed (15/15 routes generated with code 0)
verification_evidence: Full Next.js build finished cleanly with code 0. alembic upgrade head successfully creates and verifies all domain model tables.

root_cause: Absence of failure-oriented regression test coverage for parser errors, network timeouts, stale feeds, split-brain leadership scenarios, and unauthenticated geospatial services.
implementation_summary: Created 8 dedicated test suites spanning 33 failure-oriented tests plus 34 integration regression tests (totaling 67 tests). Verified that network timeouts and HTTP 500s preserve stale data rather than clearing active storms, uncalibrated datasets trigger InsufficientDatasetError/DataLeakageError, ML classifier abstains with INSUFFICIENT_CONFIDENCE under high entropy/low MSP, unauthenticated GEE returns SATELLITE_DATA_UNAVAILABLE with 0 synthetic polygons, rate limiter fails closed under Redis outage, and worker leader election tracks monotonic epoch fencing tokens.
test_results: All 67 tests across 10 backend test modules PASSED in 193.29s (100% pass rate)
verification_evidence: Pytest executed 67 tests across all domain subsystems verifying failure handling, security enforcement, dataset independence, and operational status tagging.
